attributes.action: Review and reduce benefits for people who flame they can’t work
attributes.additional_details: To reduce the strain on are taxes so that more funds go to police, schools, fire, military, nhs and other essential services
attributes.background:
Stricter guidelines for claiming benefits.
More scrutiny on what the individual is spending the money provided on.
More pressure / structure to get individual’s working and contributing to society

rejection.details: A petition needs to propose particular actions for government to take - these are too general.
